core_categories: Biotechnology; Oncology Therapeutics; Photoimmunotherapy; Medical Devices
specialty_focus: Rakuten Medical is a global clinical-stage biotechnology company specializing in precision cell-targeting therapies for oncology, using its proprietary Alluminox photoimmunotherapy platform. It develops drug-device combinations that induce selective cancer cell death via light activation, and it manufactures and commercializes related medical devices.
key_brands: Alluminox, ASP-1929, Illuminox, Alluminox Palette, IR700 dye, LOTTE Biologics, Orient EuroPharma, Cyntec, Karkinos Healthcare, National Cancer Center Japan, Rakuten Group, SBI Group, TaiAx, LI-COR Biosciences, others
